name: TaiVision-TaiTravel
description: A vision dataset focused on travel-related imagery (regional/landmark scenes) intended to evaluate models on visual recognition and potentially captioning or retrieval tasks for tourism content. It measures scene/category classification accuracy and may be used for image-to-text alignment or retrieval experiments tied to travel-related metadata.
reputation: A regionally-focused dataset available on Hugging Face with limited but growing use among researchers and practitioners working on travel/landmark vision tasks.
